title: launcHER Documentation — Home Overview
text: launcHER is a standalone PlayStation 2 forwarder built specifically to launch Ember from supported storage devices while preserving the environment Ember needs after handoff. Standalone forwarder, Ember handoff, PFS mount persistence, exFAT, ATA BDM, USB, MX4SIO, MMCE, DEV9 power preservation, OPL DB, uLaunchELF.

title: HDD Users — Read This First
text: launcHER does not require a dedicated HDD partition. The __.EMBER APA partition is only an example. Choose the path that matches where Ember actually lives: USB mass?:/EMBER/ember.elf, internal exFAT ata:/EMBER/ember.elf, or APA/PFS hdd0:<PARTITION>:pfs:/EMBER/ember.elf.

title: Why Ember Needs a Specialized Forwarder
text: Ember expects a bare game folder argument, DEV9 hardware power preservation, active PFS mount preservation for pfs0:/ access, and clean storage drivers.

title: Getting Started — Ember Directory Layout
text: Ember folder structure: EMBER/ember.elf, EMBER/bios.bin, EMBER/games/<GAME_FOLDER>/ containing cue and bin files. Constant across USB, exFAT, and APA PFS.

title: The Game Argument Rule
text: Critical rule: pass bare folder name only such as arg=Soul Blade. Do NOT pass games/Soul Blade, nor cue filenames, nor absolute paths.

title: Setup launcHER.elf and launcHER.CNF
text: Extract launcHER.elf and launcHER.CNF into your launch folder. Configure the profile matching your storage backend. Quickboot discovery automatically detects the CNF.

title: Renaming the ELF for OPL APPS
text: launcHER does not require its ELF name to match launcHER.CNF. Rename a copy of launcHER.elf to Soul Blade.ELF and keep launcHER.CNF beside it.

title: Which HDD Do I Have? — Decision Tree
text: Identify your PS2 HDD setup: USB external drive (mass?:), internal exFAT ATA BDM (ata:), mixed APA-Jail, or traditional APA/PFS partitions (hdd0:).

title: USB HDD / USB SSD (Mass Storage)
text: External spinning disks or SSDs plugged into USB ports operate as USB mass storage: path=mass?:/EMBER/ember.elf. DEV9 is not required.

title: Internal exFAT HDD (ATA BDM)
text: Internal hard drive formatted with single exFAT filesystem. Path is ata:/EMBER/ember.elf with arg=-dev9=NICHDD. No APA partitions or PFS required.

title: APA-Jail (Mixed APA + exFAT)
text: Internal HDD with APA headers followed by exFAT unmanaged space. Use ata: if Ember is on exFAT, or hdd0: if Ember is inside an APA partition.

title: Internal APA / PFS Partitions
text: Traditional Sony APA partitions formatted with PFS. Use path=hdd0:<PARTITION>:pfs:/EMBER/ember.elf. Dedicated __.EMBER is optional; __common or +OPL works too.

title: Separation of Concerns: Launcher vs Ember Location
text: launcHER and Ember do not need to live on the same device. launcHER can run from +OPL/APPS/ while Ember lives on internal exFAT ata:/EMBER/.

title: Storage Profiles — USB Mass Storage
text: USB configuration: path=mass?:/EMBER/ember.elf with arg=<GAME_FOLDER>. Supports mass?:, usb?:, and specific units like mass0:.

title: Storage Profiles — Internal exFAT (ATA BDM)
text: Internal exFAT HDD: path=ata:/EMBER/ember.elf, arg=<GAME_FOLDER>, arg=-dev9=NICHDD. Keeps the expansion bay IDE interface powered for Ember.

title: Storage Profiles — APA / PFS HDD
text: APA/PFS profile: path=hdd0:<PARTITION>:pfs:/EMBER/ember.elf, arg=pfs0:/EMBER/ember.elf, arg=<GAME_FOLDER>, arg=-skip_argv0, arg=-dev9=NICHDD.

title: Storage Profiles — MMCE & Memory Card
text: MMCE SPI SD card adapter (mmce?:/EMBER/ember.elf) and standard PlayStation 2 Memory Cards (mc?:/EMBER/ember.elf).

title: Storage Profiles — MX4SIO & i.Link
text: MX4SIO SIO2 SD adapter (mx4sio:/EMBER/ember.elf) and early fat PS2 i.Link FireWire (ilink:/EMBER/ember.elf).

title: Storage Profiles — UDPBD & UDPFS Network Boot
text: UDPBD network block device and UDPFS network filesystem with arg=-dev9=NIC. IP configuration read from mc?:/SYS-CONF/IPCONFIG.DAT.

title: Multi-Path Fallback Configuration
text: Define multiple sequential path= lines in launcHER.CNF. The first path where ember.elf is found will be booted with the shared arguments.

title: APA / PFS Two-Phase Launch Mechanism
text: Phase 1 mounts partition hdd0:<PARTITION> to pfs0: via fileXioMount. Phase 2 loads ELF and passes argv[0]=pfs0:/EMBER/ember.elf with bare game argument.

title: Anatomy of -skip_argv0 and -dev9=NICHDD
text: Deep breakdown of why -skip_argv0 is essential to replace the hdd0: loader target with pfs0:, and how -dev9=NICHDD keeps the mount table active.

title: OPL DB and wLaunchELF Handoff Tokens
text: Explains how OPL DB delivers hdd0:+OPL:pfs0:/APPS/... paths, uLE KhN passes :pfs:, and wLaunchELF R3Z passes +OPLpfs0:.

title: Robust APA Path Parser
text: parseAPAPath isolates drive prefixes, skips leading separators, detects numbered pfs0: through pfs9: tokens, and prevents in-place buffer corruption.

title: OPL APPS Integration Concept
text: Rename copies of launcHER to match game titles (e.g. Soul Blade.ELF) with launcHER.CNF beside it for seamless listing on Open PS2 Loader's APPS page.

title: OPL APPS Folder Layouts
text: Directory structures for +OPL/APPS/Soul Blade/, USB mass0:/APPS/, and internal exFAT ata:/APPS/.

title: OPL title.cfg Configuration
text: title.cfg format for custom game titles, boot ELF specifications, developers, genres, and player counts.

title: OPL Cover Art and Coverflow Setup
text: Place front covers (_COV.jpg), back covers (_COV2.jpg), icons (_ICO.png), and wallpapers (_BG.jpg) in the ART/ folder using the ELF filename prefix.

title: launcHER.CNF Syntax Rules
text: Directives follow key=value format, comments begin with # or //, filenames are case-insensitive (.CNF, .cnf, .CFG, .cfg).

title: launcHER.CNF Directives & Keys
text: Directives: path=<path> defines target ELF and can be repeated for fallbacks; arg=<value> defines sequential command-line arguments.

title: Global Launcher Flags Reference
text: Flags: -skip_argv0, -dev9=NICHDD, -dev9=NIC, -dev9=HDD, -dev9=OFF, -reset_iop, and -delay=<seconds>.

title: Direct Command-Line Invocation
text: Execute launcHER with direct command-line arguments instead of reading launcHER.CNF. Put global flags at the end of the argument list.

title: Troubleshooting Error Codes (-19, -2, -6, -22)
text: Quickboot failed: -19 ENODEV (OPL DB pfs0 token or missing partition), -2 ENOENT (missing CNF or ember.elf), -6 ENXIO (device not responding), -22 EINVAL (syntax error).

title: Black Screen After Launch Checklist
text: Resolve black screens: verify bare game folder argument, ensure bios.bin is in EMBER/, and check for arg=-dev9=NICHDD on internal drives.

title: Submitting a Bug Report
text: Guidelines for opening an issue on GitHub: PS2 model, adapter, filesystem layout, exact CNF, Ember version, and on-screen output.

title: Downloads & Releases
text: Download official release packages (launcHER.zip), standalone ELF binaries (launcHER.elf), and quickboot templates (launcHER.CNF).

title: Building from Source
text: Compile launcHER with PS2SDK, CMake 3.13+, and Docker. Build options: -DENABLE_PRINTF, -DUSE_EESIO, -DDEBUG.

title: Sony POPS & PS1 Setup Guide
text: Run PlayStation 1 VCD games using Sony POPS with launcHER: replaces POPStarter, launches .VCD images directly, and mounts storage without BDMAssault.

title: POPS External Dependencies (POPS_IOX.PAK, POPS.PAK, POPS.ELF)
text: POPS dependency requirements: POPS_IOX.PAK, POPS.PAK, or loose POPS.ELF with IOPRP252.IMG. Search priority order: game folder, device /POPS/, mc0:/POPS/, mc1:/POPS/, hdd0:__.POPS:pfs:/.

title: Preparing .VCD Disc Images (CUE2POPS)
text: PlayStation 1 Virtual CD images (.VCD) use Mode 2 Form 1 raw sectors (2352 bytes). Converted from BIN/CUE dumps using CUE2POPS.

title: POPS Quickboot and launcHER.CNF Configuration
text: Configure path= pointing directly to .VCD files across USB (mass?:), ATA exFAT (ata:), APA PFS (hdd0:__.POPS), MMCE, MX4SIO, i.Link, UDPBD, and UDPFS.

title: POPS Per-Game Directives (PATCHES.TXT, MODES.TXT)
text: Video mode overrides ($480p, $480i, $576p, $576i, $PAL2NTSC, $NTSC2PAL, $NOPAL), centering ($HDTVFIX, $XPOS, $YPOS), smoothing ($SMOOTH), CPU timing ($FASTMIPS, $SLOWMIPS), and shell boot ($NOBOOT, $BIOS).

title: POPS Compatibility Modes 1 through 8
text: Compatibility modes 1..8: Mode 1 SPU2 DMA sync, Mode 2 fast sector cache override, Mode 3 audio mixer, Mode 4 GPU FIFO sync, Mode 5 progressive timing, Mode 6 LibCrypt subchannel, Mode 7 R3000A CPU throttle, Mode 8 CD-DA buffer.

title: Built-In Game Compatibility & LibCrypt Engine
text: 568 verified game profiles and 229 validated 16-bit LibCrypt keys. Automatically reads SYSTEM.CNF serial from ISO9660 PVD and applies hardware subchannel Q emulation.

title: Virtual Memory Cards (VMC) in POPS
text: Automatic creation of formatted 128 KiB PS1 memory card images (<SERIAL>.VMC0 and <SERIAL>.VMC1). Redirection to custom folders via VMCDIR.TXT.

title: Multi-Disc Disc Swapping (DISCS.TXT)
text: Define up to 4 discs in DISCS.TXT. In-game disc swap combo SELECT + L1 + R1 cycles to the next disc image dynamically.

title: GameShark & Action Replay Cheats (CHEATS.TXT)
text: Cheat engine supporting 16-bit writes (types 80, 10), 8-bit writes (types 30, 20), conditionals (types D0..D3, E0..E1), $ prefixes, and safe mode.

title: In-Game Reset (IGR) and Controller Hotkeys
text: Controller hotkeys: In-Game Reset with L1 + L2 + R1 + R2 + SELECT + START, disc swap with SELECT + L1 + R1. Custom textures IGR_BG.TM2 and TROJAN_*.BIN fixes.

title: Custom IRX Driver Modules & Peripherals
text: Load custom IOP driver modules MODULE_0..9.IRX, peripheral drivers USBMOUSE, USBKBD, GUNCON, DS3, DS4, and driver manifests MODULES.TXT and IRX.TXT.
